# ctables/index

> Indexing: `x[i]` on a `str` or a slice, with a bounds check.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/index.pkg) · translates [std/index](../std/index.md)

  The index is compared unsigned, so negative indexes fail too, and an
  index out of range calls `__pk_panic_index` from [panic](panic.md). The
  `addr` sections give the element's address, for assignment and `&`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
({ W {L.a} =
{x}
; W {L.b} =
{i}
; if ((uint64_t){L.b} >= (uint64_t)((W *){L.a})[0]) __pk_panic_index(); (W)((B *){L.a})[8 + {L.b}]; })
@panic
```

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
({ W {L.a} =
{x}
; W {L.b} =
{i}
; if ((uint64_t){L.b} >= (uint64_t)((W *){L.a})[1]) __pk_panic_index(); (W)((B *)((W *){L.a})[0])[{L.b}]; })
@panic
```

### `emit`

```nasm
({ W {L.a} =
{x}
; W {L.b} =
{i}
; if ((uint64_t){L.b} >= (uint64_t)((W *){L.a})[1]) __pk_panic_index(); ((W *)((W *){L.a})[0])[{L.b}]; })
@panic
```

### `emit addr when self size 1`

```nasm

{x}
; W {L.b} =
{i}
; if ((uint64_t){L.b} >= (uint64_t)((W *){L.a})[1]) __pk_panic_index(); (W)&((B *)((W *){L.a})[0])[{L.b}]; })
@panic
```

```nasm

{x}
; W {L.b} =
{i}
; if ((uint64_t){L.b} >= (uint64_t)((W *){L.a})[1]) __pk_panic_index(); (W)&((W *)((W *){L.a})[0])[{L.b}]; })
@panic
```
